description: Type annotations and class definitions for protobuf messages related to the Data Broker API, generated by mypy-protobuf for serialization/deserialization of data points, metadata, and subscription requests.

classes.name: GetDatapointsRequest
classes.description: Request message for retrieving data points, containing a list of requested data point identifiers.

classes.name: GetDatapointsReply
classes.description: Reply message containing requested data points, with nested DatapointsEntry for key-value pairs.

classes.name: SubscribeRequest
classes.description: Request message to subscribe to data points based on a query string.

classes.name: SubscribeReply
classes.description: Reply message containing subscribed data points, with nested FieldsEntry for key-value pairs.

classes.name: GetMetadataRequest
classes.description: Request message for fetching metadata of data points by names.

classes.name: GetMetadataReply
classes.description: Reply message containing metadata list for requested data points.

methods.name: ClearField
methods.description: Method to clear a specified field in the message.
